records.overall_input: A blocked Stop pipeline, its content-free diagnostic, and the current vault Git state.
records.overall_outcome: One bounded local recovery attempt that either reports the exact resulting commit, reports no-change, or stops with the unchanged fail-closed diagnostic.
records.local_subgoal: Repair only the repository-owned vault transaction and make the result auditable without introducing another writer or retry loop.
required_outcome_evidence: The pre/post HEAD comparison reports the exact new commit SHA or the explicit no-change outcome, while a remaining COMMIT_BLOCKED state preserves the exact dirty paths.
records.change: Record HEAD before repair and require the post-repair report to distinguish an exact committed SHA from no-change.
records.behavior_proof: The skill still delegates writes to vault-write.py and the existing Stop owner, performs one attempt, remains offline, and does not broaden staging or cleanup authority.
